headline: Turkmenistan Exchange Registers $11.3 Million Fuel Export Transactions
summary: The State Commodity and Raw Materials Exchange of Turkmenistan completed two sales of diesel fuel totaling $11.34 million with trade partners in Afghanistan and the United Arab Emirates.
why: Turkmenistan's state commodity exchange controls export trade transactions for the nation's natural gas, petroleum products, and petrochemical output.

impacts.name: Turkmenistan
impacts.why: State energy export sales generated $11.34 million in foreign currency revenues.
